primaryPublication.cohort: Eight HVTN087 HIV-vaccine trial participants sampled before and after vaccination
UK children and adults with healthy, COVID-19 and post-COVID blood samples
Seven Stanford COVID-19 patients and six asymptomatic adult controls
Korean COVID-19, influenza and healthy PBMC cohort

inputs.donorIdentityScope: Donor identifiers are scoped to each primary study; source publications document recruitment and sample provenance

costs.referenceAccessDefinition: Build and load the mapping-reference descriptor from existing analysis artifacts
costs.memoryDefinition: Sampled container memory.current and process-tree RSS, using the same Sampler as external mapping comparators
costs.timingBoundary: Fresh prepared matched H5ADs; original source assembly and input downloads excluded from analysis steps

evaluation.rareTypeRule: Reference frequency below 1% with at least 20 reference cells
evaluation.bootstrapUnit: Donor within each query study; all donor cells retained together
evaluation.coverageRule: Descending confidence; ties use a fixed seeded cell permutation; unassigned cells remain unassigned
